__meta__.description: Degree/credential ranking table for ApplyEngine's highest-qualification reducer (implementation_plan.md §2.5). Keys are lowercase degree-name keywords found in real education-level dropdowns and field labels; values are integer ranks, higher = more advanced. Only relative order matters — the reducer sorts profile.education by this rank and takes the top entry when a form asks for a single 'highest qualification' rather than a repeated history. Spaced by 10s (not 1-7) so an intermediate tier can be inserted later without renumbering everything.

changelog.1.1.0: Fixed 'undergraduate' being ranked below 'associate' (now merged into the bachelor's tier). Added higher-secondary/pre-university tier (Intermediate, FSc, FA, HSC, A-Levels) and postgraduate-diploma tier. Renumbered 1-6 to steps of 10. Folded professional doctorates (MD, JD, PharmD, DDS) into the same top tier as PhD.
